summary.text: The revised workbook changes one formula on the Pricing sheet, and the Summary total it feeds changes too.

changes.explanation: On the Summary sheet, the value in B3 changes from $31,127.80 to $29,828.80, a decrease of 1,299.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This changes a total shown in the workbook.

changes.explanation: On the Pricing sheet, the formula in E5 changes from =B5*C5*(1-D5) to =B5*C5*(1-D5)*0.95, so its result is now multiplied by 0.95.
changes.why_it_may_matter: This may change the value this cell shows; DiffNexa does not calculate formulas.
